integrity: Two self-contained Python 3 standard-library programs independently reproduce the finite code census, component decomposition and dihedral orbit.
scientific_limitations: Finite wheel first-occurrence theorem through order 14 only. A 2015 paper about optimal code ensembles was unavailable beyond its abstract; historical priority remains qualified. No larger-wheel classification or independent audit is claimed.
title: First nontrivially fragmented optimum global locating-domination slide graph in wheels: \(W_{14}\)
